response.overview: The documentary film Gora Rocka takes viewers to the heart of one of Slovenia’s most unique festivals—an event that has spent over two decades demonstrating that music can bring people together while simultaneously transforming the community. Through energetic concert highlights and personal stories, the film reveals the behind-the-scenes world of the Gora Rocka festival on the Šentviška Planota plateau in the Tolmin region. It is a charity rock festival co-created annually by over 360 volunteers, with all proceeds dedicated to helping the local community and individuals in need.
response.tagline: Trese se gora, špila se rock!
response.title: Gora rocka
